title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. interpretation of dream 1521 views Q. asalamualaykum mufti sahab, I had seen a dream. Time was after fajr. My marhoom grand mother came in my dream and gave me foreign currency, which i was feeling that the value of the same in indian currency is very huge. Then i gave the money to my cousin to count the money. She counted and gave the same back to me. Please tell me the meaning of the dream. 6038 views Q. میں نے خواب دیکھا کہ میری بیوی نے دو لڑکے جنم دیئے ، بیوی ابھی تک حقیقی زندگی میں حاملہ نہیں ہوئی ہے۔کیا اس خواب کی کوئی تعبیر ہے؟ 1397 views Q. Mufti Shaheb, Somebody (male) has touched the private body parts of another person(male) intentionally. Is just making Tawba is enough for him, or he has to seek forgiveness from the second person? Jazakallah 1418 views Q. میں نے کہیں سنا ہے کہ اگر کوئی نئے شہر میں داخل ہو تو اسے اس شہر کی پیاز کھانی چاہئے ، 1040 views Q. I was going to marry my cousin without the consent of her parents after eid ul fitr but her mother did some black magic on her and she changed. me and my family is going through a tough time due to this but my grandmother[who is pious] has seen in her dream two times that we are having a party at home what does this mean? 1576 views Q. dream 1156 views Q. Regarding dreaming hujur sallallahu alaihi wa sallam 1640 views Q. I have a question regarding a dream I had. First I need to give you a background of the situation. I married a few months back and with the grace of Allah, my husband and I are trying to have a child. During last week, my mother has had dreams every night about babies and flowers and eating fruits and sweets. She tells me she thinks it is because I may be pregnant. Before I went to sleep one night after my mother told me this, I made dua to Allah to show me a sign in a dream whether I am pregnant or not and then I went to sleep. During that night, I had a dream that a lady doctor has come to my house and she is telling me that she can detect two pulse readings in my body, and she is telling me it is good news (that I am pregnant), in the dream I feel happy, and then I woke up. Please tell me what the meaning of this dream is, and if this relates to the dreams my mother is having almost every night about babies and me being pregnant. JazakAllah Khair. 1635 views Q. My question is regarding a dream which my wife saw sometime back 1499 views Q. Assalam o Alaikum Warahmatullahe Wabarakatuhu Mofti sahb, I am in circumstances where I have to take some very important decision. The situation is that I am living in Dubai, UAE with my family. I got married in 2007 and Allah Blessed me with a daughter this year. My wife, daughter and mother all live with me here in Dubai. My father was died long back and I am taking care of my mother. As you know, due to increasing inflation it is very difficult to save some money. I could not save any single dirham for last two years since when I came here in dubai.and also sometime a satuation come that it becomes very difficylt to pass the month in my earning So I am thinking whether to keep my family here with me and keep living without saving any money and just trust on Allah that situation will get better or if I send my family back home (Pakistan), I can save reasonable amount every month. So before making the final decision, I decided to do ''Istikhara'' as sunnah. Yesterday night, I abolute and offered two nawaffil and then recite dua for correct guidance from Allah SWT and then slept without talking to anybody. I saw a dream that I want you to give me ''tabeer'' for. I saw that I am standing by a closed grave which is made of white marble (and I felt in dream that this is my own grave). I am dusting the grave and I am saying to my wife with so much grief that how would you live without me (meaning that when I will go into the grave). That''s it. I don''t know whether this dream is meaningful or not. Or it has any connection with ''Istikhara'' but I simply request you to please guide me on this. Jazakumullaho khair. 1489 views Q. a-o-a I had a dream about my uncle around a year later after his death were I see my self praying in the front row of a Friday prayer with all levels of people gathered. Then when I turn around, I see my uncle talking and laughing at his son explaining that in life he should take responsibility and that my uncle is safe and health. From physical description I see him in white cloths, well built in muscle, happy looking, with a black sheet covering his left side and stuff like kajal, topi, small beard, white skin even if he was a bit brown before death. I feel like everything isn?t right, as if I have been shown this dream to take care of his family. The first thought I had when I awake from the dream was marrying his daughter who I haven?t seen yet. What should be done, and what from your knowledge this dream really means? I was told by my parents that they are converting to chiasm and they are so young, I am in my 20ties and am not strong enough to be trusted by them. I feel really worried. By Muhammed Faizan Mustafa My second question is that I see him again in a second dream a few months later were he is looking at me in a cloudy crowd, but I am not so confident about it because it was short and more of a vision then a dream. What does this mean and what does he want me to do. Why do I see this dream when I have never lived with him by. 1543 views Q. کیا امام ابن تیمیہ حق اسکالر تھے یا نہیں؟اور کیا عقیدہ اور توحید کے بارے میں ان کی کتاب مستند ہے یا نہیں؟ 1163 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 38502 Country: India Title: I am feeling very much tension to join fardh prayer (by jamah) but due to some reason I am unable to perform Question: (1) I am feeling very much tension to join fardh prayer (by jamah) but due to some reason I am unable to perform (i) The jamah is over and I want to go to other mosque to get jamah but I lost my sleeper, shoes. (ii) The people performing salah in mosque in opposite direction of Qiblah (East direction). (iii) There are many statues (animal faces) in front of people performing salah in mosque. (2) I am traveling by train or other means, some time I miss my main train and traveling in other train and I am feeling very tension. Sometime my companion has missed the train. I am feeling very tension in traveling by any other means. (3) I am using toilet which is opened or visible to other people but I have no other option to use other and I am feeling very bad. Answer ID: 38502 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 865/529/H=1433) (1) Your dream is very important. It indicates that the religious conditions of Muslims are declining rapidly. May Almighty Allah give Muslims taufiq to follow the religion strictly! Amen! (2&3) You pay more attention to world than the hereafter. May Almighty Allah remove this shortcoming! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
